fit_reason: Whole van offered by a private owner in the cars-by-owner section.
findings: Hood paint looks dull and blotchy with uneven reflection across the top in the front photo
Rear doors look slightly dull and faded compared with the side panels
Front bumper caps and bug deflector look a bit grey and faded rather than deep black
Lower body cladding and side molding strip look slightly chalky
Headlight lenses look mildly hazy in the front photo
Light road film on the lower rear corners and around the rear step bumper
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Ram Van shorty and it looks like a really clean one. In the photos the hood paint looks a little dull and blotchy, and the black bumper caps are starting to fade. We do a mobile pre-sale buff and trim restoration that would bring that dark cherry back up to a deep gloss before buyers come out. Would you like a quote?
